"I recently ordered a money bouquet from NS Gift Hub for my future wife, Unaiza, and I cannot thank Ms. Namra enough for her incredible work.

The bouquet was absolutely stunning and was loved by not just Unaiza, but her entire family as well. They were so impressed by the gesture and the thoughtfulness behind it. The service and the way they treat their customers are commendable. Their behavior, nature, and communication are exceptionally good—they are such humble people. Also, they are very fair with their pricing; they charge exactly what their hard work deserves.

A small piece of constructive feedback: I also ordered a gajra to be worn on the hand, but unfortunately, it wasn't as durable and kept breaking. I hope that next time, the quality of the gajra will match the high standard of their other work.

Overall, I highly recommend NS Gift Hub to anyone looking to make their special occasions even more memorable. Thank you once again, Ms. Namra, for making my special day even brighter!"
